# Fork publication manifest

Copy these 827 files into `acceptance/sk-cbor/` in an OpenSK fork, on a branch based on the pinned subject commit. Paths below are relative to the package root.

Excluded: `_run/`, all `BRIEF*.md`, `published/`, `work-sk-cbor/`, generated source checkouts, targets, `.cargo-home`, validator checkouts, caches and git metadata. The enclosing fork supplies `libraries/cbor` and its history. Runtime copies and executables are regenerated offline.

`python3 acceptance/publish.py` regenerates this list. `python3 acceptance/publish.py --copy <fork>/acceptance/sk-cbor` copies exactly these files. Package files are Apache-2.0 OR MIT; third-party texts retain their original licences.
